user_query: My company is organizing an event on sustainable development and we need to gather information about climate change. Please fetch the climate change news from The Guardian and provide us with the articles from Energy Price News that cover the European region.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest climate change news articles from The Guardian.
Filter the retrieved Guardian articles to find those related to sustainable development.
Fetch articles related to climate change from Energy Price News that cover the European region.
Compile and summarize the relevant articles from both The Guardian and Energy Price News.
